description: Create a debt payoff planning spreadsheet using the avalanche method. The spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/debt_payoff_plan.xlsx contains 5 debts with their details. Your task: (1) In column F, assign priority ranking where 1=highest interest rate (Credit Card A at 23.99% should be rank 1, down to Student Loan at 4.25% as rank 5). (2) In cell B10, create a SUM formula to calculate total debt. (3) In cell B11, create a SUM formula for total minimum payments. (4) In cell B12, calculate extra payment available: 800 minus total minimums. (5) Apply visual highlighting (background color or bold) to the entire Credit Card A row (row 2) to show it's the priority target. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
